# root = country, scope:target = the loan, scope:owner = the lender if it exists (vanilla comment). The X1 loans are
# known by their loc key (oe_itp_loan_<slot>), so the handler does not depend on root.
on_loan_repaid = { on_actions = { oe_itp_oa_repaid } }
oe_itp_oa_repaid = {
    trigger = { current_year >= 1200 exists = scope:target }
    effect = { oe_itp_on_repaid = yes }
}

# root = the country that went bankrupt. Rule REBELTAG: a civil-war rebel state keeps the tag BYZ.
on_bankruptcy = { on_actions = { oe_itp_oa_bankrupt } }
oe_itp_oa_bankrupt = {
    trigger = { current_year >= 1200 tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no has_variable = oe_itp_on }
    effect = { oe_itp_bankrupt = yes }
}
